name: Agent demo: ask, work, result
suits: an agent demo: ask, work, result
show the deliverable, not the dashboard

spine.note: A second of the finished deliverable with the film's title over it, so the viewer knows what is about to be made.
The product's chat surface. The ask types in, in full, with its attachment shown; held long enough to read every word. Nothing over it.

The agent works: a checklist ticks through its steps by name (the tools it called), then the elapsed time it took. The honesty beat. Nothing over it. When the brief asks for a real place (an office, a desk), found footage may lie under the surface as its ground.

The deliverable full frame, with its own sound if it has one; two claim lines land over it one at a time, the second completing the first ('X plans it.' / 'Y ships it.'); the ask of the viewer ('Add X to Y.') lands over its LAST three seconds, the same footage continuing. Nearly half the film.

type.note: four lines in the whole film: a title, two claims, one ask over the result's last seconds; each fades in and holds

layers.surface: one product surface performs the ask and the work, scripted (the composer types, the tool calls tick); the deliverable owns the frame after

music.note: the deliverable may carry its own sound; no bed under the surface

asks.screens: the deliverable: a recording or screenshot of the real output (or a generated clip); the product surface is a library mock scripted with the ask and the tool calls
